assembledAt.why: the state of this repository when the table was written; not a measurement, a date on a reading

unit: per 1,000 pages, US regions, first pricing tier; an entry billed per document says so, and what a document is
whatThisIs: LIST PRICES, READ ON A DATE. Nothing here is measured, and every figure moves: vendors change tiers, regions differ, negotiated contracts differ more.

The audit uses one of these only when a chain declares no price of its own. Declare yours with: npm run grade -- --price-per-thousand-pages=<dollars>. A declared price is marked declared in the record; a price taken from here is marked list-price, with this file's date.

The 2026-09-29 entries were read by the founder on the vendors' public pricing pages. The environment that assembled this file could not re-read those pages (its network policy denies aws.amazon.com, azure.microsoft.com and cloud.google.com), so each of them says verified: false until someone re-reads it and flips it, with the date. The Google Document AI Expense Parser entry was re-read on 2026-10-04 and says verified: true, with that date.
A vendor bills per page (or per document), once, whatever the number of fields you take from it. That is why the unit is pages and not fields, and why a routing that reads two vendors pays both.

aws-textract-analyzeexpense.toConfirm: third-party summaries read on 2026-09-29 give 8 per 1,000 pages for this product; the official page decides

azure-document-intelligence-prebuilt.product: prebuilt models (invoice, receipt, ID, W-2 and others)
azure-document-intelligence-prebuilt.tier: pay as you go, first 1,000,000 pages per month

google-document-ai-expense-parser.perCount: the page bills 0.10 USD per count at list price, and one count is a document of up to 10 pages; a receipt is one page, so one receipt is one count and 1,000 receipts are 100 USD
google-document-ai-expense-parser.tier: list price; no monthly tier is carried here. The same page lists 0.09 USD per count under a 1-year savings plan and 0.08 USD under a 3-year plan, neither of which this table applies

notListed: Products not in this table (Textract Queries, Tables, Layout; Azure Read, Layout, custom; Document AI OCR and Invoice parsers, custom extractors) were not read and are therefore not priced here. Declare their price rather than guess it.
